mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sale_event (ticket_id, from_status, to_status, operator_id, remark) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{fromStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operatorId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_id, from_status, to_status, operator_id, remark, created_at FROM after_sale_event WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
